title: Shibby Bondage Set and Competition Announcement (ORIGINAL)
description: Shibby's Bondage Set! It's finally here! Following in the footsteps of my Shibby's Pet Chastity Cage I can now proudly present my "Claimed by Shibby" bondage set and Art Scavenger Hunt Competition (more on that down below). This has been a while in the making, and there has been plenty of back and forth refining the design, colour, attachments etc. Thank you to oxy-products for all their constant help throughout it’s making. Whilst it has been fun and all, testing out prototypes on subs, and even myself. What I really want is for you to be bound by Me. Not just by my words, but physically restrained with nowhere to go. Doesn't that just sound delicious? Ever since I made the audio Hi I'm Shibby, and Soon You'll Be a Strapped Down Squirming MESS I've wanted my own branded bondage set. From then on I wanted to know without a shadow of doubt just how restrained I had you, for you to feel the visceral, tactile grip of Me holding you in place. So, let me tell you a bit more about them. Limited to 300 pieces with numbered dogtags, get your favorite number before it's gone forever. With three given away to three lucky winners in the art scavenger hunt. They're a leather burgundy with a beautifully embroidered hypnotic spiral that runs the length of the collar. Both the cuffs and collar are stamped on the underside, so my name will always be pressed tight against your skin. Shibby Claiming you. And, just like anything I do, I wanted something that was unique to me but more importantly, I wanted them to be a great bondage set for everyone. Not just for personal use, but with partners too. That is why it has partly taken so long to release. A lot of iterations have gone through, making sure it should fit everyone and anyone comfortably, so comfortably in fact, you can sleep in it... I wonder how I might know that... And you are definitely not getting out of these things no matter how much you wriggle and squirm. Included in the box is: • A wide leather collar with D-ring, embroidered with hypno-spiral band • Your unique Slave #XXX pendant • Matching leather wrist cuffs (x2) • A lovely little leather connector bar with swivel snap clips • Brass padlocks for locking wear So... What is your new number, slave? Shibby’s Art Scavenger Hunt Competition To celebrate the bondage set going live, I thought you might enjoy a little competition to show just how devoted you truly are to my files over the years. I’d love for you all to take part, and I’ll also be giving away three bondage sets to lucky winners. This also comes with the added prestige of some of the lowest numbered dogtags it is possible to own. Purely for bragging rights among the Discord of course. The premise of the art hunt is simple: There are 20 clues, all you have to do is match them to the corresponding artwork by GodfreySmash. Shibby’s Art Scavenger Hunt Competition Once you think you’ve finalized your answers, send them off to [email protected] by copying the clues and writing beside it which corresponding numbered artwork you think it matches with. The competition is planned to run for two weeks and then winners will be drawn at random. Here are your clues and best of luck! 1) Etched Loyalty 2) She Protecc 3) Close to My Heart 4) Mindless for Latex 5) Whose A Good Girl? 6) Marital Bliss 7) Worshipping your Goddess 8) Shibby’s First Fan Art 9) Claimed 10) My Sweet Boy 11) Tapped Out 12) Hi or Lo 13) It Starts With Sorry 14) Encased In My Gaze 15) Put A Bow On It 16) Pulling You Down Deeper 17) Orgasmic Contributions 18) The File That Never Was 19) You’re Fucked 20) Clever Girls Competition ends 19th May 2026. Get your entries in before it closes.
